_comment: Per-chart narratives. CI (build_prompt.py -> GitHub Models -> write_narrative.py) overwrites these from live numbers; this committed copy is the fallback so the page always reads well. source = 'fallback' | 'github-models'.

notes.basket: The breakfast basket, an index averaging coffee, sugar, wheat, and orange juice prices with 2015 as the base year (100), stands at 132, reflecting a 32% rise since 2015. This increase has been uneven across commodities and is largely driven by recent price moves rather than steady growth. The index captures general breakfast-related commodity costs on a global scale.
notes.movers: Coffee prices surged 93% since 2015, the largest individual increase, followed by orange juice at 22%, wheat at 7%, and sugar at 5%. These movements are primarily due to weather events and diseases affecting crops, such as frost and drought in coffee-growing areas and citrus greening plus hurricanes impacting orange juice. These soft commodities trade in thin markets, meaning smaller supply disruptions can sharply impact prices, rather than reflecting broad inflationary trends.
notes.why: The headline rise in the breakfast basket is driven by a few weather-sensitive crops that face ongoing production risks. Given the nature of these markets, elevated price levels can persist for several years if adverse conditions continue.
